title: mtg-nest-benchmark
description: compression and retrieval benchmark of the 38,627-card magic: the gathering image corpus packed into single-file .nest containers with the nest engine: av1, avif and jpeg xl media variants, lossless batteries, inter-frame ordering over same-artwork reprints, an all-intra codec battery at matched ssimulacra2, and retrieval-only profiles measured on identity, embedding drift and text-to-image hit@k against a 3.975 GB jpeg source. the citation key of a specific .nest file is its content_hash.
notes: the license is to be decided by the maintainer. zenodo's github integration needs a public repository, so the doi is minted when the repository goes public.
